content_sections.heading: RARI Ahmedabad Senior Research Fellow (Ay.) Walk-in Interview Date, Time and Venue
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

content_sections.heading: About RARI Ahmedabad
content_sections.text: The Regional Ayurveda Research Institute, Ahmedabad (RARI) works under C.C.R.A.S., Ministry of AYUSH, Govt. of India, and functions from Block A & D, Second Floor, Bahumali Bhavan, Manjushri Mill Compound, Nr. Girdharnagar Overbridge, Asarwa, Ahmedabad – 380 004 (Gujarat). This Senior Research Fellow (Ay.) post is for the project "Efficacy of Ayush RP as an add on to the standard of care in the management of Sickle Cell Disease among the Adolescent-A Randomized Double Blind Controlled Trial". The institute can be reached on 079-29708072 and 079-29708044, or by email at [email protected] and [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: One post of Senior Research Fellow (Ay.) is to be filled. The essential qualification is a B.A.M.S. Degree from any Recognized University. The age limit is up to 35 years, and age will be reckoned as on 01.12.2026. The notice lists these desirable points: Preference will be given to those who possess higher qualification or who have previous research experience, i.e., having worked for any research project funded by the Ministry of AYUSH, ICMR, DST or equivalent organization. Skills of drafting and editing of scientific documents, articles, technical reports etc. Publication in peer reviewed journals. Knowledge of computer applications such as MS Office, etc. The remuneration is fixed at Rs. 42000/- per month, and HRA is payable on top of it as per rules. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Bio-data in the prescribed format, downloaded from the Council's website www.ccras.nic.in Self-attested Xerox copies of the required certificates Original documents Two recent passport size photographs

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates must be present at the venue on 14 December 2026 and report between 09:00 and 11:00 am. As per the necessity, a written test will be conducted. Selection will be based on the performance in the written test/interview. Candidates can give the interview in Hindi as per their choice. No TA/DA will be admissible for the interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The engagement is initially for a period of six months, which may be curtailed or extended at the discretion of the competent authority subject to performance. The engagement will be co-terminus with the project. The engagement will be purely on contractual basis, with no right to claim continuation or regular appointment. The selected candidate should be willing to travel to any area of Gujarat State and Daman & Diu for project work. The selection committee has the right to select or reject the application of the candidate. The Institute In-Charge, RARI, Ahmedabad reserves the right to postpone or cancel the interview without assigning any reason.

faq.question: Q1. When is the RARI Ahmedabad Senior Research Fellow (Ay.) walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 14 December 2026, with reporting time 09:00-11:00 am.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the walk-in interview held?
faq.answer: It is held at Regional Ayurveda Research Institute, Ahmedabad, Block 'A' & 'D', Second Floor, Bahumali Bhavan, Manjushree Mill Compound, Nr. Girdharnagar Overbridge, Asarwa, Ahmedabad, Gujarat-380004.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There is 01 post of Senior Research Fellow (Ay.).

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the Senior Research Fellow (Ay.) post?
faq.answer: A B.A.M.S. Degree from any Recognized University is essential; higher qualification or research experience in a project funded by the Ministry of AYUSH, ICMR, DST or equivalent organization is preferred.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is up to 35 years, reckoned as on 01.12.2026, with relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PH persons as per Central Govt. rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of the Senior Research Fellow (Ay.)?
faq.answer: The fixed remuneration is Rs. 42000/- per month, with HRA as per rules paid on top.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I bring to the walk-in?
faq.answer: Bring the bio-data in the prescribed format from www.ccras.nic.in, self-attested Xerox copies of the required certificates, original documents and two recent passport size photographs.

faq.question: Q8. How will the candidate be selected?
faq.answer: Selection will be based on performance in the written test/interview; a written test will be conducted as per the necessity.

faq.question: Q9. Is the Senior Research Fellow (Ay.) post permanent?
faq.answer: No, the engagement is purely contractual, initially for six months, may be curtailed or extended subject to performance, and is co-terminus with the project.

faq.question: Q10. Will travel allowance be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No, the notice states that no TA/DA will be admissible for the interview.
